armyRules.name: Last Stand of the Broken Fleets
armyRules.flavor: With no fleet left to retreat to, every survivor fights to the last.
benefits: While a Unit with this Special Rule is at half strength or fewer, every Model in it adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule can never voluntarily Fall Back.
armyRules.condition: while at half strength or fewer

armyRules.name: Mixed Banners
armyRules.flavor: Survivors of seven Legions follow whoever is still standing.
benefits: Friendly Units within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule add 1 to their Cool Characteristic.
drawbacks: If a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty, every friendly Unit within 12" of it must immediately pass a Cool Check or gain the Pinned Tactical Status.

armyRules.name: Held Together by Spite
armyRules.flavor: Too stubborn to stop, too broken to run.
benefits: A Dreadnought with this Special Rule has the Feel No Pain (6+) Special Rule.
drawbacks: A Dreadnought with this Special Rule cannot Rush.

wargear.name: Wall of Names banner
wargear.summary: A tattered banner stitched with the names of everyone who didn't make it off the world.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Wall of Names banner, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Willpower and Intelligence Characteristics.

wargear.name: Patched refractor field
wargear.summary: A refractor belt salvaged from a dead officer and repaired with whatever was to hand.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Patched refractor field has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Field-welded plating
wargear.summary: Hull plates from three different wrecks, welded onto an Ancient who refuses to stay dead.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Field-welded plating, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Wounds Characteristic.

wargear.name: Ashes reliquary
wargear.summary: A sealed urn of soil from a homeworld that no longer exists.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Ashes reliquary has the Ashes Remembered Special Rule.

wargear.name: Cracked void-plate
wargear.summary: Armour that once sealed a ship's airlock and has outlasted three owners.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Cracked void-plate has the Scar-Hardened Special Rule.

wargear.name: Tithe crate
wargear.summary: The last of the squad's ammunition, handed round before the final push.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Tithe crate gives its Unit the Tithe of Shells Special Rule.

wargear.name: Rally beacon
wargear.summary: A hand-cranked lamp whose pattern every survivor of the old fleets still knows.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Rally beacon gives its Unit the Rally Flare Special Rule.

wargear.name: Slab-plates
wargear.summary: Slabs cut from fallen hulls and bolted over every joint.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with Slab-plates, every Model in that Unit has the Slab-Plated Special Rule.

wargear.name: Orphaned machine-spirit
wargear.summary: A cogitator core that has lost its crew and learned to watch for itself.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with an Orphaned machine-spirit, every Model in that Unit has the Vigil Spirit Special Rule.

rules.name: Muster Call
rules.summary: Seven Legions' worth of orphans answer a single call.
rules.text: While at least one other friendly Inductii Unit is within 12" of a Unit with this Special Rule, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making a Cool Check.

rules.name: Survivor's Oath
rules.summary: Whoever else is dead, somebody has to carry the story out.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of a friendly Garviel Loken, Saul Tarvitz, Shadrak Meduson, Alexis Polux or Hibou Khan, every Model in that Unit adds 1 to its Cool Characteristic when making a Cool Check. A Model with this Special Rule that is Locked in Combat, or Engaged in a Challenge, with an enemy Model of the Traitor allegiance adds 1 to all Wound Tests it makes in that Combat, up to a total bonus of +1 from this Special Rule and any Hatred (X) Special Rule combined.

rules.name: Dig In
rules.summary: If you cannot leave, you had better dig in.
rules.text: A Model with this Special Rule has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule against Shooting Attacks while its Unit did not move during its own most recent Move Sub-Phase.

rules.name: Ancient Resolve
rules.summary: The oldest warriors have already died once and see no reason to flinch now.
rules.text: A Unit with this Special Rule is immune to the Fear (X) Special Rule and automatically passes every Cool Check it is required to make. It must be deployed on the Battlefield and cannot be held in Reserves.

rules.name: Ashes Remembered
rules.summary: The soil of a dead homeworld, carried to the next battle.
rules.text: Friendly Shattered Legions Units within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule add 1 to their Cool Characteristic when making a Cool Check. Once per battle, the Controlling Player may declare that the Unit including that Model automatically passes one Cool Check it is required to make.

rules.name: Scar-Hardened
rules.summary: Armour that has outlasted three owners refuses to give up a fourth.
rules.text: The first Wound allocated to a Model with this Special Rule in each battle is discarded.

rules.name: Tithe of Shells
rules.summary: The last of the ammunition, handed round before the final push.
rules.text: Once per battle, when a Unit with this Special Rule makes a Shooting Attack, each Ranged Weapon used adds 1 to its Firepower Characteristic for the duration of that Shooting Attack.

rules.name: Rally Flare
rules.summary: A lamp pattern every survivor of the old fleets still knows.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of a friendly Player Turn, the Controlling Player may remove one Tactical Status from the Unit that includes a Model with this Special Rule, and one Tactical Status from one other friendly Unit within 12".

rules.name: Slab-Plated
rules.summary: Slabs cut from fallen hulls and bolted over every joint.
rules.text: Each unsaved Wound inflicted on a Model with this Special Rule inflicts 1 less Damage, to a minimum of 1.

rules.name: Vigil Spirit
rules.summary: A machine-spirit that has lost its crew and learned to watch for itself.
rules.text: Once per battle, when an enemy Unit ends a Move within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, that Model may immediately make a Shooting Attack against that Unit, subtracting 1 from its Ballistic Skill Characteristic for the Hit Tests.

modifiers.text: Cornered men fight hard: +1 WS, -1 LD.
Hard-won veterans of the broken fleets: +1 A, -1 CL.
Held together by prayer and spite: +1 BS, -1 M.
Wall of Names banner: +1 WP, +1 IN.

rites.name: Broken Banners Reforged
rites.flavor: Seven Legions' worth of orphans, one muster call.
benefits: Inductii Squads of any Legion gain Line (2).
Inductii gain Muster Call: +1 Cool for Cool Checks while another friendly Inductii unit is within 12".
limitations: At least two Inductii Squads are required.
No Armour or Lord of War units.

require.note: Field at least two Inductii Squads.

modifiers.text: Broken Banners Reforged: Muster Call, Line (2).

rites.name: Oath of the Survivors
rites.flavor: Whoever else is dead, somebody has to carry the story out.
benefits: Every Legion Infantry unit gains +1 Willpower and Survivor's Oath: +1 Cool for Cool Checks while within 12" of one of the army's named survivors.
Under Survivor's Oath, those units add 1 to Wound Tests against Traitor Models in combat, sharing a single +1 with any Hatred (X) they already have.
limitations: Garviel Loken, Saul Tarvitz, Shadrak Meduson, Alexis Polux or Hibou Khan must be in the army.
No Lord of War units and at most one Armour unit.

require.note: A named survivor must lead the oath.

modifiers.text: Oath of the Survivors: +1 WP, Survivor's Oath.

rites.name: Fortress of the Last Stand
rites.flavor: If you cannot leave, you had better dig in.
benefits: Heavy Support Squads, Tactical Support Squads and Rapier Batteries may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those units gain Dig In: Shrouded (6+) while they have not moved this turn.
limitations: At least one Rapier Battery is required.
No Fast Attack or Recon units.
No unit may use Outflank, Infiltrate or Deep Strike.

require.note: Bring at least one Rapier Battery.

modifiers.text: Fortress of the Last Stand: Dig In, Line (1).

rites.name: The Ancients Awake
rites.flavor: When the Legions died, their oldest warriors stayed in their coffins and kept fighting.
benefits: Contemptor, Castra Ferrum, Deredeo and Leviathan Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Those Dreadnoughts gain Ancient Resolve: they are immune to Fear and automatically pass Cool Checks.
limitations: At least two War Engine units are required.
No Tactical, Despoiler or Assault Squads.
Dreadnoughts with Ancient Resolve may not be held in Reserve.

modifiers.text: The Ancients Awake: Ancient Resolve, Line (1).
